notes: Variant assumption is a chest-supported incline-bench dumbbell Y raise using light dumbbells and a thumbs-up or neutral hand position. The strongest direct evidence uses prone floor or rehabilitation Y/full-can patterns rather than an incline bench, so the entry notes this limitation. A standalone lower trapezius label was not used because local anatomy exposes only Trapezius (middle and lower fibers); validation confirms that visible label resolves.
